offline.center.title: Sync
offline.center.subtitle: What this device captured offline, and what is still waiting to be sent.
offline.center.nothing: Nothing waiting: everything captured on this device has been sent.
offline.center.blockedHelp: These items need fixing: the server refused them on their merits, not because of a dropped connection. Correct the entry or remove the item.
offline.center.waitingHelp: These items refer to something created offline that has not reached the server yet. They will go out on their own once it does.
offline.center.snapshots: Reference data held on this device
offline.center.snapshotsHelp: An encrypted local copy, refreshed whenever you are online. It is what lets you work without a network; it never stands in for a fresh read.
offline.center.discardConfirm: Remove this item for good? What was captured will be lost.
offline.center.limitsBody: Posting an entry, issuing a numbered invoice, taking a payment, filing a return and closing a financial year each carry a legal number or an outside effect. They cannot be replayed from a device: the application refuses them offline rather than queueing them.
offline.unavailableBody: This screen needs the server. It will open again when the network is back.
offline.partners.fromSnapshot: Offline: list from the local copy, and it may be incomplete.
pwa.installPrompt.title: Install ARCOMPT on this computer
pwa.installPrompt.body: Work even without internet: what you enter stays on this device and syncs automatically when the connection comes back.
pwa.installPrompt.ready: Your basic data is already stored for offline work.
pwa.installPrompt.done: ARCOMPT is installed: you can work offline.
pwa.installPrompt.guideIntro: Your browser does not offer an install button. Just do this:
pwa.installPrompt.guide.chromium.1: Open the browser menu: the three dots, at the top right.
pwa.installPrompt.guide.chromium.2: Choose “Install ARCOMPT” — or “Save and share”, then “Install app”.
pwa.installPrompt.guide.chromium.3: Click “Install”. ARCOMPT appears on your desktop, like any program.
pwa.installPrompt.guide.safari.1: Tap the Share button: the square with an arrow pointing up.
pwa.installPrompt.guide.safari.2: In the list, choose “Add to Home Screen”.
pwa.installPrompt.guide.safari.3: Tap “Add”. ARCOMPT appears like an app.
pwa.installPrompt.guide.firefox.1: This browser does not offer installation on a computer.
pwa.installPrompt.guide.firefox.2: Open arcompt.com in Chrome or Edge: the install button will be waiting there.
pwa.installPrompt.guide.firefox.3: Meanwhile, ARCOMPT works right here, and your data syncs the same way.
pwa.installPrompt.guide.other.2: Look for “Install app” or “Add to Home Screen”.
pwa.installPrompt.guide.other.3: Confirm: ARCOMPT appears like an app on this device.
pwa.installCard.title: ARCOMPT on this device
pwa.installCard.body: Install ARCOMPT to open it like an app, without going through the browser, and to work even without internet.
pwa.installCard.installed: ARCOMPT is installed on this device. You can work offline: everything syncs when the network returns.
